name: Open a community tool library by spring
goal: Open a community tool library by spring

tasks.text: Write the goal in one sentence: Open a community tool library by spring
Say what done looks like and how it will be measured
List who is involved and who decides
Note the limits: money, time, people
Break the goal into its main pieces of work
Put the pieces in order and mark what depends on what
Give each piece an owner and a date
List what could go wrong and what would be done about it
Start with the piece everything else depends on
Check progress every week against the dates
Write down each decision and why
Test the result against what done looks like
Ask the people it is for
Fix what the test and the people found
Hand over: who looks after it now
Write what worked and what to do differently

note: No AI key is saved, so this is QueryBook's standard five-phase plan for any goal. With a Claude or Gemini key the tasks are written for your goal.
